message.content: You are implementing Task B5 of the "DD Agent Logs via Vector" plan. ## Task Description Update the DD Agent module's README to document the new `logs_intake_url` variable. **File to modify:** `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/IAC/terraform/internal-modules/kubernetes/monitoring/datadog-agent/README.md` Two edits: ### Edit 1: Add `logs_intake_url` to the Inputs table The Inputs table is around lines 33-58. Locate the row for `log_level` (it should sort alphabetically; the table appears to be roughly alphabetized by name). Insert immediately after the `log_level` row: ``` | [logs\_intake\_url](#input\_logs\_intake\_url) | OPW-compatible logs intake URL. When set, the agent ships logs to this endpoint via DD\_OBSERVABILITY\_PIPELINES\_WORKER\_LOGS\_URL. For cluster-internal Vector use module.vector.service\_endpoint\_dd\_agent. When null (default), logs ship direct to Datadog SaaS. | `string` | `null` | no | ``` (Note: keep underscores escaped as `\_` in markdown to match the table's existing style.) ### Edit 2: Append an "OPW Logs Intake" section At the end of `README.md`, append: ``` ## OPW Logs Intake (optional) By default, the agent ships logs directly to Datadog SaaS over HTTPS. To redirect logs through a Datadog Observability Pipelines Worker (OPW), or through a Vector deployment functioning as one, set `logs_intake_url`: ```hcl module "datadog_agent" { # ... logs_intake_url = module.vector.service_endpoint_dd_agent # e.g. "http://vector.vector.svc.cluster.local:8282" } ``` This sets two env vars on the agent containers: - `DD_OBSERVABILITY_PIPELINES_WORKER_LOGS_ENABLED=true` - `DD_OBSERVABILITY_PIPELINES_WORKER_LOGS_URL=` Agent-side processing rules (`DD_LOGS_CONFIG_PROCESSING_RULES`) continue to execute before transmission, regardless of destination. Metrics and APM (traces) are unaffected and continue shipping direct to Datadog. When `logs_intake_url` is `null`, the rendered helm values are byte-identical to the v1.1.x line — there is no behavior change for clusters that do not opt in. Reference: ``` ## Context Documentation only. No tests. ## CRITICAL — No git operations Do NOT run any git commands. Sir Charles handles git himself. ## Your Job 1. Read README.md to identify the right insertion points. 2. Make both edits. 3. Self-review by re-reading the file and confirming both edits are present. 4. Report back. ## Report Format - **Status:** DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT - File modified - The line numbers where each edit landed - Any concerns
